records.name: wholeSourcesAndLocator
records.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,datetime,os
p=Path('docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/warm-weather-outfit-worth')
files=[Path('docs/research/KNIT-CHARACTER-TARGET-2026-10-04.md'),Path('docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/knit-character-turnaround/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md')]
rows=[]
assert all(q.stat().st_size<=16384 for q in files) and sum(q.stat().st_size for q in files)<=24576
for q in files:
 b=q.read_bytes();z={'path':str(q),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()};rows.append(z);print('WHOLE',json.dumps(z));print(b.decode())
args=['rg','-n','-i','warm.?weather|camp.collar|summer|hidden.?tee','docs/WORK-WINDOW-2026-10-18.md'];r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode in [0,1]
hits=r.stdout.splitlines();assert len(hits)<=16, 'locator budget exceeded; no continuation'
x={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'pid':os.getpid(),'wholeReceiptPins':rows,'locator':{'args':args,'exit':r.returncode,'rows':hits,'count':len(hits),'scope':'Limited source selection, no global absence claim.'}}
(p/'LOCAL-INPUTS.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(x,indent=2))
PY
